/.title: Pizzeria El Chocolate | Authentic Cuban Pizza in North Fort Myers, FL
/.description: Authentic Cuban pizza in North Fort Myers, FL: thick sweet crust, golden edge-to-edge cheese, lobster and alligator pies, croquetas, tropical shakes and chocolate pizza.
/.body:
Open daily 11 AM–9 PM. 899 Pondella Rd, North Fort Myers, FL 33903. Phone (239) 946-9006.

Cuban pizza from $10.99, specialty lobster and alligator pies, croquetas, tropical shakes and chocolate pizza.

/menu.title: Menu | Pizzeria El Chocolate — Cuban Pizza, Croquetas & Shakes
/menu.description: The full Pizzeria El Chocolate menu: Cuban pizza from $10.99, lobster and alligator specialty pies, homemade croquetas, Cuban-style spaghetti, tropical shakes and chocolate pizza.
/menu.body:
Cuban Pizza / Pizza Cubana

Thick, slightly sweet dough, Cuban-style sauce and cheese baked golden right to the edge.

  • Cheese (Queso) — $10.99
  • Onion (Cebolla) — $11.99
  • Pepper (Ají) — $11.99
  • Mushroom (Hongos) — $11.99
  • Ham (Jamón) — $11.99
  • Pepperoni — $12.99
  • Chorizo — $12.99
  • Bacon — $12.99
  • Tuna (Atún) — $12.99
  • Hawaiian (Hawaiana) — $12.99

Specialty Pies / Especialidades

From the sea and the swamp. For when you came hungry.

  • Mixed (Mixta) — $15.99. Ham, chorizo, pepper & onion
  • Shrimp (Camarones) — $17.99
  • Prawn (Langostino) — $21.99
  • Lobster (Langosta) — $22.99
  • Alligator (Cocodrilo) — $26.99. The house legend

Starters / Aperitivos

Something to pick at while the pie bakes.

  • Garlic Bread (Pan de Ajo) — $3.99
  • Homemade Croquetas (Croquetas Caseras) — $1.75. Ham, chicken, salt cod, cheese & more — ask for today's flavors

Spaghetti / Spaghetti

Cuban-style, the way abuela makes it.

  • Napolitano — $8.99
  • Ham (Jamón) — $9.99
  • Chorizo — Ask us
  • Lobster (Langosta) — Ask us

Shakes / Batidos

Tropical fruit, blended to order.

  • Chocolate — $4.99
  • Mamey — $4.99
  • Soursop (Guanábana) (Guanábana) — $6.99

Dessert / Postres

There's a reason we're called El Chocolate.

  • Chocolate Pizza (Pizza de Chocolate) — $9.99. Chocolate spread & powdered sugar
  • Cheese Creama (Creama de Queso) — Ask us
